story.title: Coforge CEO: AI Is Changing Tech Services Demand, Not Killing It — Firms That Lead Outcomes Will Win
story.summary: Coforge CEO Sudhir Singh has publicly pushed back against narratives of AI-led demand collapse in IT services, arguing that the market is evolving into new value pools centred on AI-led modernisation and governance. He dismissed fears of AI firms displacing traditional IT services companies, framing them as specialists within a broader, growing market. The statement carries weight given Coforge's Q4 FY26 profit more than doubled to Rs 612 crore, suggesting its own AI-driven approach is yielding results.
